tools.name: list_windows
tools.description: List visible top-level windows with hwnd and title. Optional filter by window_title. Use only when you need to browse or disambiguate windows; otherwise pass window_title directly to list_controls or navigate(action=focus).

parameters.name: window_title
parameters.description: Partial window title filter

tools.name: list_controls
tools.description: List a window's controls by window_title or hwnd. Returns element indices (#N), roles, labels, control hwnds where available and window-relative @x,y WxH. Prefer control hwnds for subsequent actions. Refresh element indices after UI changes.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Window or control handle in hex (0x...) or decimal.

parameters.name: window_title
parameters.description: Partial window title if hwnd is not provided.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: Max tree depth override. Use 0 with a control hwnd to refresh that control only.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Pointer and focus actions. action=click|double_click|drag|scroll|focus. Target with element=# from list_controls (needs hwnd/window_title), hwnd, or x/y in the same space as screenshot for that scope. Drag from the target to to_element, to_x/to_y, or the center of to_hwnd/to_window_title, in that order. click/double_click/drag optional button=left|right|middle and optional modifiers (ctrl/shift/alt/win). scroll needs direction=up|down|left|right and optional amount (default 3). Success may note new dialog/window hwnds.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: click, double_click, drag, scroll, or focus.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Control/window handle; also scopes element and x/y.

parameters.name: window_title
parameters.description: Partial window title for focus, scroll, element scope, or x/y.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: 1-based element index from the latest list_controls for that window. For drag, this is the start element.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: Match list_controls max_depth when targeting by element; omit if that listing used the default.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X in screenshot space for the current scope. For drag, start X.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y in screenshot space for the current scope. For drag, start Y.

parameters.name: to_element
parameters.description: For drag: 1-based element index within the destination window. Match its list_controls max_depth.

parameters.name: to_hwnd
parameters.description: For drag: destination control/window handle; scopes to_element and to_x/to_y, or targets its center when neither is supplied.

parameters.name: to_window_title
parameters.description: For drag: partial destination window title if to_hwnd is not provided.

parameters.name: to_x
parameters.description: For drag: end X relative to the destination window, or the starting scope if no destination window is supplied.

parameters.name: to_y
parameters.description: For drag: end Y relative to the destination window, or the starting scope if no destination window is supplied.

parameters.name: button
parameters.description: Mouse button for click/double_click/drag: left (default), right, or middle.

parameters.name: modifiers
parameters.description: Keys held during click/double_click/drag: ctrl, shift, alt, and/or win (e.g. ctrl+shift). Forces synthetic mouse input (skips UIA invoke).

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Scroll direction: up, down, left, or right.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Scroll wheel ticks (default 3).

tools.name: set_control_text
tools.description: Replace the text of an edit control without typing. Target with element=# from list_controls (needs hwnd/window_title) or a control hwnd. Prefer this over send_keys (if available) whenever the control is listed.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Control or window handle in hex (0x...) or decimal; also scopes element.

parameters.name: window_title
parameters.description: Partial window title used to scope element.

parameters.name: element
parameters.description: 1-based element index from the latest list_controls for that window.

parameters.name: max_depth
parameters.description: Match list_controls max_depth when targeting by element; omit if that listing used the default.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to set in the control.

tools.name: send_keys
tools.description: Send keystrokes to the foreground window. Syntax: plain text, {Enter}, {Tab}, ^c (Ctrl+C), +a (Shift+A), !f (Alt+F). Use navigate(action=focus) first when possible.

parameters.name: keys
parameters.description: Key sequence to send.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a window (hwnd/window_title) or the full virtual desktop as a JPEG. Click image x/y with navigate using the same scope. Prefer list_controls when the control tree is usable.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Window handle in hex (0x...) or decimal.

parameters.name: window_title
parameters.description: Partial window title if hwnd is not provided.
